INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.1Attentive Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 1.1.1Attentive Listening.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 1.1.1Attentive Listening.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.1Attentive Listening.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 1.1.1Attentive Listening.

2. In INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Only memorise without using the language
   B. Mix random languages with no purpose
   C. Avoid speaking to classmates
   D. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day

3. When practising Reading 3.2.1 Reading for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   B. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 3.2.1 Reading for Information.

----

13. In three clear sentences, explain Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Self- expression: Pronunciation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
